verses.en: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.pt: Oráculo acerca do deserto do mar. Como os tufões de vento do sul, que tudo assolam, aí vem do deserto, duma terra horrível.
verses.en_web: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.
verses.en_bbe: The word about the waste land. As storm-winds in the South go rushing through, it comes from the waste land, from the land greatly to be feared.

verses.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.pt: Dura visão me foi manifesta: o pérfido trata perfidamente, e o destruidor anda destruindo. Sobe, ó Elão, sitia, ó Média; já fiz cessar todo o seu gemido.
verses.en_web: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
verses.en_bbe: A vision of fear comes before my eyes; the worker of deceit goes on in his false way, and the waster goes on making waste. Up! Elam; to the attack! Media; I have put an end to her sorrow.

verses.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
verses.pt: Pelo que os meus lombos estão cheios de angústia; dores apoderaram-se de mim como as dores de mulher na hora do parto; estou tão atribulado que não posso ouvir, e tão desfalecido que não posso ver.
verses.en_web: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have taken hold on me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I so am dismayed that I can’t see.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I am full of bitter grief; pains like the pains of a woman in childbirth have come on me: I am bent down with sorrow at what comes to my ears; I am shocked by what I see.

verses.en: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
verses.pt: O meu coração se agita, o horror apavora-me; o crepúsculo, que desejava, tem-se-me tornado em tremores.
verses.en_web: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
verses.en_bbe: My mind is wandering, fear has overcome me: the evening of my desire has been turned into shaking for me.

verses.en: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
verses.pt: Eles põem a mesa, estendem os tapetes, comem, bebem. Levantai-vos, príncipes, e ungi o escudo.
verses.en_web: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
verses.en_bbe: They make ready the table, they put down the covers, they take food and drink. Up! you captains; put oil on your breastplates.

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.pt: Porque assim me disse o Senhor: Vai, põe uma sentinela; e ela que diga o que vir.
verses.en_web: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
verses.en_bbe: For so has the Lord said to me, Go, let a watchman be placed; let him give word of what he sees:

verses.en: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.pt: Quando vir uma tropa de cavaleiros de dois a dois, uma tropa de jumentos, ou uma tropa de camelos, escute a sentinela atentamente com grande cuidado.
verses.en_web: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
verses.en_bbe: And when he sees war-carriages, horsemen by twos, war-carriages with asses, war-carriages with camels, let him give special attention.

verses.en: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.pt: Então clamou aquele que viu: Senhor, sobre a torre de vigia estou em pé continuamente de dia, e de guarda me ponho todas as noites.
verses.en_web: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
verses.en_bbe: And the watchman gave a loud cry, O my lord, I am on the watchtower all day, and am placed in my watch every night:

verses.en: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.pt: E eis aqui agora vem uma tropa de homens, cavaleiros de dois a dois. Então ele respondeu e disse: Caiu, caiu Babilônia; e todas as imagens esculpidas de seus deuses são despedaçadas até o chão.
verses.en_web: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
verses.en_bbe: See, here come war-carriages with men, horsemen by twos: and in answer he said, Babylon is made low, is made low, and all her images are broken on the earth.

verses.en: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.pt: Ah, malhada minha, e trigo da minha eira! o que ouvi do Senhor dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, isso vos tenho anunciado.
verses.en_web: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
verses.en_bbe: O my crushed ones, the grain of my floor! I have given you the word which came to me from the Lord of armies, the God of Israel.

verses.en: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.pt: Oráculo acerca de Dumá. Alguém clama a mim de Seir: Guarda, que horas são da noite? guarda, que horas são da noite?
verses.en_web: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
verses.en_bbe: The word about Edom. A voice comes to me from Seir, Watchman, how far gone is the night? how far gone is the night?

verses.en: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
verses.pt: Respondeu o guarda: Vem a manhã, e também a noite; se quereis perguntar, perguntai; voltai, vinde.
verses.en_web: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
verses.en_bbe: The watchman says, The morning has come, but night is still to come: if you have questions to put, put them, and come back again.

verses.en: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.pt: Oráculo contra a Arábia. Nos bosques da Arábia passareis a noite, ó caravanas de dedanitas.
verses.en_web: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.
verses.en_bbe: The word about Arabia. In the thick woods of Arabia will be your night's resting-place, O travelling bands of Dedanites!

verses.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.pt: Saí com água ao encontro dos sedentos; ó moradores da terra de Tema, saí com pão ao encontro dos fugitivos.
verses.en_web: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
verses.en_bbe: Give water to him who is in need of water; give bread, O men of the land of Tema, to those in flight.

verses.en: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.pt: pois fogem diante das espadas, diante da espada desembainhada, e diante do arco armado, e diante da pressão da guerra.
verses.en_web: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
verses.en_bbe: For they are in flight from the sharp sword, and the bent bow, and from the trouble of war.

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.pt: porque assim me disse o Senhor: Dentro de um ano, tal como os anos de jornaleiro, toda a glória de Quedar esvaecerá.
verses.en_web: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
verses.en_bbe: For so has the Lord said to me, In a year, by the years of a servant working for payment, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end:

verses.en: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.
verses.pt: e os restantes do número dos flecheiros, os valentes dos filhos de Quedar, serão diminuídos; porque assim o disse o Senhor, Deus de Israel.
verses.en_web: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
verses.en_bbe: And the rest of the bowmen, the men of war of the children of Kedar, will be small in number: for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said it.
